body:
The `simdesign-widerweb` summary in `site/projects.json` on `main` contained repeated, garbled text. This rewrites it from the project README's results (0.5 mm step, three radii, three meshes; shift not resolved beyond about one step). `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Also logs the run in `prompts/runs.jsonl`. The other unmerged branches were left alone: their slugs are already on `main`, and `simdesign-gaugepockets` duplicates `simdesign-pocketmesh`.
